summary: legal checked in 6 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Recommendation: keep private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms restrict the proposed commercial/public use. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; no certification. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional when it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries and adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Compliance and data-quality disposition: ordinary growth is conditional, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry. Analytics is healthy for configured sites; data quality is green except revenue attribution is yellow because one provider aggregate row remains unattributed. Preserve unknowns and do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where compliance, rights, security, accuracy, consent, disclosure, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, or age-sensitive evidence is missing.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are evidenced closed and 4 remain open. Existing progress is limited to official Woot API/terms/support review, partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed and is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. No public display, alert expansion, affiliate use, advertising, remarketing, or secondary monetization is cleared.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Require a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blockers.

items.title: Maintain private launch gate and complete evidence work
items.summary: Maintain SearchWoot as private and preview-only while rights, privacy, consent, data-flow, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete.

Permit only bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.
